[ASSISTANT_SAID] NikkieTutorials is an amazing source of inspiration, and the mentioned products are fantastic.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] To enhance a natural look, start with a good base using a lightweight foundation that matches skin tone.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended foundations: MAC Pro Longwear Foundation, Nars Sheer Glow Foundation, Laura Mercier Foundation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For concealing imperfections, use a concealer one shade lighter than foundation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended concealers: Nars Radiant Creamy Concealer, Tarte Shape Tape Concealer.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Define brows using a brow pencil or brow mascara.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended brow products: Anastasia Beverly Hills Brow Wiz, Benefit Gimme! Brow!  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Enhance lash line with a brown or neutral eyeshadow and a light brown or black eyeliner.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended products for eyes: Urban Decay Naked Palette, Charlotte Tilbury 24/7 Eye Pencil.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Add a healthy glow with a subtle highlighter applied to high points of the face.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended highlighters: Becca Shimmering Skin Perfector, Nars Albatross Highlighter.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Contour wisely with a light hand, focusing on defining the jawline and sides of the nose.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended contour products: Nars Laguna Bronzer, Charlotte Tilbury Wonderglow.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Find a perfect nude lip color that complements natural lip color.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended lip products: Nars Audacious Lipstick, MAC Matte Lipstick in Fresh Brew or Twig.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips include blending well, practicing, and maintaining a good skincare routine.  
[EVENT] User is interested in learning more about contouring.  
[PREFERENCE] User wants specific tips on contouring their face shape and product recommendations for beginners.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Contouring is about subtle definition; start with a light application and build up as needed.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Identify face shape to contour effectively; there are six basic face shapes: Oval, Round, Square, Heart-Shaped, Triangular, and Diamond.
